nyheter.title: A Last Look at ‘Old Salt’: Former USS Nimitz Sailors Say Goodbye
nyheter.summary: ABOARD AIRCRAFT CARRIER USS NIMITZ — Four hundred former USS Nimitz (CVN-68) sailors and their families streamed off buses on Pier 14 at Naval Station Norfolk, Va., and up the brow of the oldest carrier in the Navy for a final goodbye. The guest of honor was the first commander of the carrier, 94-year-old Rear Adm. Bryan Compton.
